repos_data.description: Python SDK for the FlashAlpha options analytics API — live options screener, gamma exposure (GEX), DEX/VEX/CHEX, options flow, 0DTE, VRP, volatility surfaces, greeks

MCP server for ApexVol options analytics — options chains, IV rank, VRP, Greeks, GEX, expected moves, and screeners for Claude and any MCP client. Remote connector or pipx install; works with any paid ApexVol plan.
